changelog.change: Initial weights: unit points for the ten quality signals, provisional +1 proof signals, the slop penalties, the judge at +1/-2, and the thresholds of DESIGN sections 5 and 6.
changelog.evidence: Pooled AUC 0.962 and uniform AUC 0.945 on the 149 research labels (research/raw/haystack/final_eval.py); unit weights, not fitted ones, because only 9 uniform positives exist.

changelog.change: Retired the provisional s.incoherent (at least 5 checkable references cited in the README and under 40% of them resolve) from -1 to 0 points. It is still evaluated and shown as a chip, 'README cites missing files', but it adds nothing to S, pointsMax or coverage, and it is no longer provisional.
changelog.evidence: Of the five known firings, four are on repositories labelled G and one is on a re-upload, where the missing paths were runtime outputs rather than false claims. First live run (review finding scoring-3): a genuine Debian packaging tool (3 of 14 resolve; blind label G) and a re-upload of another author's project (1 of 8; blind label C); both READMEs document files the tool itself generates. Blind-check deep experiment (research/blind-check-2026-09-11.md): a genuine Android and ESP32 project, label G, lost 1 point to it. Recorded fixtures: it fires only on the seed gems codefly-dev/cli (3 of 11 resolve) and montezuma-p/harken (2 of 6), both G, and on no red-team fixture. It cannot fire on the 149 research snapshots (no file tree), so the pooled and uniform AUC (0.961 / 0.945), the Goodhart AUC (0.437 / 0.322) and the calibration fit do not move (unsung eval --labels fixtures, before and after).

changelog.change: Initial calibration: the slope from a logistic fit of genuine on points over all 149 research labels, the intercept set so that the mean predicted rate on the uniform stratum equals its smoothed base rate (10 / 71).
changelog.evidence: research/raw/haystack/final_eval.py on the 149 research labels (74 genuine; uniform stratum 69, of which 9 genuine); uniform Brier score 0.041.
